description: A gradient cut to a rounded border box, with a border drawn over it.

florui.css: .box { width: 120px; height: 80px; border: 6px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 24px; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5a5f, #3a86ff); }

classification.reason: Besides the one-level dithering of a gradient, the pixels along the anti-aliased rounded corners of the box and of its border differ from Chromium by up to 50 levels, 1.75% of the pixels (an anti-aliasing difference of the rounded border that the plain border-radius fixtures also show), geometry an exact match.
